# Lines check-english.py may report but that are French on purpose.
# One entry per line: `path-glob | regex matched against the line, or * for the whole file | reason`.
# The reason is required. Built-in exceptions (French copies, private notes, i18n French dictionaries
# `**/lang/fr.json`, docs/glossary.md, lockfiles) are listed in check-english.py (ALLOWED_PATHS).
README.md | Lire en français | link to the French translation, written in French for French readers
CONTRIBUTING.md | Lire en français | link to the French translation, written in French for French readers
.github/scripts/check-english.py | * | the French word lists are the data of the check
.github/scripts/test_check_english.py | * | French lines are the fixtures of the check's test
.github/scripts/check-english-allow.txt | * | this list quotes the French lines it allows
.github/scripts/verify-adr.py | ^(FR_[A-Z_, ]+ =|    \('\d{3}-[a-z0-9-]+\.md', ) | ADR-011's French vocabulary and file names, read only in a base that still has them by ADR-026's one-time translation mapping
docs/adr/016-read-only-npm-registry-for-agents.md | `MAL-` | prefix of the OpenSSF malicious-packages entries, a third-party name
.github/workflows/adr-proposals.yml | ^ +OLD_TITLE: | title of the issue opened before the English switch, found once and retitled by the workflow (ADR-026)
*.k6.js | \bvus: | k6's own option name (virtual users), a third-party API
.github/workflows/engine.yml | orchestrateur/ | main keeps the engine's French path until step 10 merges the switch: the mutation ratchet reads main's reference there and fails if neither path exists (note §4.2)
ROADMAP.md | Alpine\.js/Petite-Vue | third-party name (petite-vue), not French
orchestrator/tests/a-r6.test.ts | jargon\('Le (schéma des données|SCHÉMA)'\) | deliberate French fixtures: the A-R6 jargon list of the French dictionary is checked, accents and case included
orchestrator/tests/instructions.test.ts | accents é and « quotes » | deliberate fixture: accented letters and French quotes are ordinary text, never refused as invisible characters
orchestrator/tests/i18n.test.ts | 'Tableau de bord : https://d/cycles/1' | deliberate fixture: the rendering of the French dictionary (lang/fr.json) is checked
